title: Bust Length Sketch of Margot in a Big Hat and a Red Dress

said.q: Many of the girls, as in Bust Length Sketch of Margot in a Big Hat and a Red Dress, wear elaborate chapeaux. Inspired by seventeenth-century Dutch and Flemish portraits as well as English portraits of the Romantic period, Cassatt updated the genre.
